# CreditRights

> CreditRights helps people in the UK check whether they could claim back interest and charges on credit they couldn't afford: bank overdrafts, credit and store cards, personal and payday loans, catalogue accounts, and guarantor, doorstep and logbook loans. It is a trading name of Claim Simple Ltd (FCA FRN 830182, company 11459714), which introduces eligible people to Recoup (Clear Legal Limited, SRA 469975) to run their claim.

Key facts:

- You can complain to your bank or lender, then the Financial Ombudsman, yourself for free.
- Our partners pay us when we introduce your claim.
- If a claim succeeds, Recoup's fee is a percentage of the refund within the regulator's cap: 36% (max £504) on refunds up to £1,499, falling to 18% (max £12,000) on £50,000 or more, including VAT. Full details: https://creditrights.co.uk/fees/
- Our check takes about a minute and involves no credit check.
- There is no phone line; contact is by email (support@creditrights.co.uk) or post.

## Main pages

- [Home and claim check](https://creditrights.co.uk/): who can claim and how to start
- [What you can claim for](https://creditrights.co.uk/claim-types/): the types of lending covered, each with its own guide
- [How it works](https://creditrights.co.uk/how-it-works/): the steps and typical timescales
- [Fees](https://creditrights.co.uk/fees/): the success-fee bands and when fees apply
- [FAQs](https://creditrights.co.uk/faq/): common questions about claiming
- [About us](https://creditrights.co.uk/about-us/): who runs CreditRights and how we are paid
- [Received a letter?](https://creditrights.co.uk/received-a-letter/): for people who have had a letter from us
- [Contact](https://creditrights.co.uk/contact/)

## Claim types

- [Bank overdrafts](https://creditrights.co.uk/claim-types/overdrafts/): in the red most months
- [Credit and store cards](https://creditrights.co.uk/claim-types/credit-cards/): limits that kept going up
- [Payday loans](https://creditrights.co.uk/claim-types/payday-loans/): one loan after another
- [Personal loans](https://creditrights.co.uk/claim-types/personal-loans/): repayments you couldn’t afford
- [Car finance](https://creditrights.co.uk/claim-types/car-finance/): payments you couldn’t afford
- [Catalogue accounts](https://creditrights.co.uk/claim-types/catalogues/): shop now, pay later
- [Guarantor loans](https://creditrights.co.uk/claim-types/guarantor-loans/): for borrowers and guarantors
- [Doorstep loans](https://creditrights.co.uk/claim-types/doorstep-loans/): home credit
- [Logbook loans](https://creditrights.co.uk/claim-types/logbook-loans/): secured on your car
- [Buy now, pay later](https://creditrights.co.uk/claim-types/buy-now-pay-later/): new rules from july 2026
